name: Studio: grey backdrop, dawn rim light (cut-outs)
description: completely replace the cream backdrop of the incoming image with a plain, flat, mid-grey seamless studio backdrop and nothing else in the frame, lit from the right by strong low warm golden dawn light that rims her hair, shoulders and gown, with a soft cool blue fill from the left, her feet fully visible on the plain floor with a faint soft shadow
notes: Same lighting direction for every character in a group shot, so the cut-outs match when composited.
